web-browsers to our Primary server in Folsom by utilizing the following URL:
https://iso_si/iso <https://alhibk1b/iso>  .    Also, please be advised that
you should clear the Netscape cache, close all open Netscape windows, and
re-start Netscape, before attempting to log onto the primary site.  


		Please contact Ginger Seitles (916) 351-4420 or
gseitles@caiso.com <mailto:gseitles@caiso.com>  if you have any questions or
